# Sitepresso — full reference for AI engines

> Sitepresso is a website builder SaaS for small businesses to create marketing websites,
> booking websites and e-commerce websites — no code required. Sites can go live in minutes.

## What Sitepresso is

Sitepresso lets a small or local business build and publish a professional website without code.
It is built around three website types ("verticals"), each with industry-specific themes:

1. **Marketing websites** — a professional brand presence: home, about, services, portfolio/gallery,
   contact and enquiry forms, plus local SEO pages. For consultants, agencies, trades, clinics, NGOs.
2. **Booking websites** — everything a service business needs to take appointments online: a service
   menu with prices, staff/practitioner profiles, availability and calendar, an online booking form
   with confirmations and reminders. For salons, barbers, dentists, doctors, physios, spas, tattoo
   studios, tutors, gyms, yoga studios, law firms, accountants and more.
3. **E-commerce websites** — an online store: product catalogue, categories, cart, checkout,
   payments, delivery/pickup, order management, offers and coupons. For grocery, fashion, beauty,
   jewellery, bakery, florists and other retailers.

## Who it is for

Small businesses, local businesses, professionals, clinics, salons, restaurants, retail stores,
trades, consultants and other service businesses who want a professional website quickly and
affordably, without hiring a developer.

## Features

- Industry-specific themes with distinct designs and vocabulary per profession
- Layouts and color systems
- Custom domains (bring your own, or a free sitepresso.com subdomain)
- SEO settings (meta titles/descriptions, sitemaps, robots, canonical, per-page overrides, redirects)
- AI-assisted content generation
- Online booking and appointment management (booking vertical)
- Online store, cart, checkout and payments (e-commerce vertical)
- Multi-language support

## How it works

Pick your industry, choose a theme and plan, customise content visually, connect a domain, and go
live. No coding or design skills required.
